description: Test suite for command polling backoff logic, including calculation of backoff time, command polling state management, and associated utility functions.

methods.name: calculateBackoffMs
methods.description: Calculates the delay in milliseconds based on the poll count; returns capped maximum delay after certain retries.

methods.name: getCommandPollSuggestion
methods.description: Returns current backoff delay for a specific command, if tracked.

methods.name: pruneStaleCommandPolls
methods.description: Removes stale command poll entries older than a specified max age.

methods.name: recordCommandPoll
methods.description: Records a command poll, updating the backoff state and resetting counters if output is received.

methods.name: resetCommandPollCount
methods.description: Removes the polling count record for a specific command.
